tests.test: original is byte-exact and identical across three independent mirrors
tests.detail: sha256 e11f4e6c41ec798b9f663cb99d1c7950853fde2b0125060fdfaf1209b9d3b5ed for the Princeton (1996), UPenn (1997) and CMU (1998) copies; source/original.gif is the unmodified Princeton copy (5319 bytes, GIF87a, 506x232).

tests.test: identity: window in the image matches the program source
tests.detail: GUIWindow.java (same mirror) calls setTitle("The AWT Components") and builds exactly the visible java.awt components (Menu, Canvas, Label, TextArea, List, TextField, Button, Checkbox, Choice). Manually compared against the image at 3x.

tests.test: candidate files match their Commons file pages
tests.detail: SHA-1 of AWT_at_Linux.png = c4279edf45b40192aebca4795c13ff05420e3124 and Easy_Java_AWT_example.jpg = 1372dbe57815234298a1965d9439cb5af47360ac, as published on each file page.
Image region of the export, nearest-downsampled to 506x232, is byte-identical to the original's RGB pixels. No crop.

tests.test: safe area and dimensions (automated in build_frame.py)
tests.detail: exports/editorial-frame.png 1920x1080; image box [201,161,1719,857] and credit box [205,891,1715,919] inside safe area [120,72,1800,1008]; proofs/editorial-frame-720.png 1280x720.

tests.full_size: Viewed exports/editorial-frame.png at 1920x1080: whole window including all four border corners and title bar present; pixel-doubled edges crisp with no smoothing or colour shift; every widget label legible; credit line fully readable, not clipped; no watermark, no personal data, no added UI.
tests.proof_720: Viewed proofs/editorial-frame-720.png at 1280x720: title, Menu, list items, TextField/Button/Checkbox/Choice labels and the credit line remain readable; the small canvas coordinate labels (10,10)/(50,50)/(100,100) are soft but legible and non-essential.

tests.test: privacy scan of the selected image
tests.detail: GUIWindow.gif contains only generic component labels. The page's separate FileDialog.gif shows a Sun employee's home-directory path; it was deliberately not downloaded or used.

toolchain.downloader: curl (Git for Windows), anonymous HTTPS GET

notes: Produced as an internal proof. Release is blocked: the selected image is Sun copyright, all rights reserved (R14 open).
Two public-domain Commons fallbacks are preserved in evidence/candidates/ but are 2006-2007 captures, not 1995-96 AWT.
state.json and delivery.json are excluded from the hashed inventory.
